dataset.name: MCW cross-platform pancreatic-cancer cohort (GSE313117)
dataset.description: Independent pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with whole-transcriptome bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The retrospective single-center study included 79 patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma whose archival tumors were profiled by both whole-transcriptome RNA-seq and a commercial exome-capture assay. TRACE Explorer retains only the 79 whole-transcriptome profiles, which the source study treated as the reference assay, and excludes every matched exome-capture profile to avoid counting each patient twice or mixing platforms.
dataset.publication_citation: Lee et al. npj Precision Oncology 2025

metadata.source_program: Medical College of Wisconsin retrospective PDAC cohort
metadata.library_method: Ribo-depleted whole-transcriptome RNA-seq from FFPE tumor material; KAPA RNA HyperPrep with RiboErase and approximately 60 million reads per sample
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival with clinical follow-up through September 2024
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source clinical file reports OS time in months and event status but does not specify the exact time origin. TRACE Explorer therefore exposes source-provided OS without claiming harmonization to a diagnosis-, treatment- or surgery-anchored definition.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only sample titles ending in whole transcriptome are eligible. The matched exome-capture profiles and their separate TPM matrix are excluded before endpoint and expression QC.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned GEO clinical CSV contains one rnaseq_name, subject identifier, OS time and OS event code for every retained whole-transcriptome library. GEO sample descriptions independently provide the exact Library name: rnaseq_N linkage used to join all 79 records.
metadata.overlap_note: The source publication describes a retrospective single-center cohort and does not report reuse of TCGA, ICGC, CPTAC, POG570 or the UAB GSE79668 cohort.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Redistribution of the source matrices is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Archival FFPE pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumor profiled by whole-transcriptome RNA-seq

expression.label: GEO whole-transcriptome TPM transformed to log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: HUGO-style gene symbols supplied as row identifiers in the pinned GEO whole-transcriptome matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The pinned source matrix contains 24,416 non-empty gene symbols with no case-insensitive duplicates, so no feature collapse is required.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) to the source-provided whole-transcriptome TPM values. The matched exome-capture TPM matrix is intentionally excluded because its assay coverage and abundance scale differ from whole-transcriptome RNA-seq.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded in the source OS.code field
